sovereign_country.strategic_role: 苏伊士运河经济特区、辐射中东及北非的低成本轻工制造

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Manufacture of Portable Phased-Array Medical Diagnostic Scanners

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (French-influenced) with Islamic Sharia as the principal source of legislation; administrative decisions subject to annulment by the State Council (Conseil d'Etat)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law No. 80 of 2002 on Combating Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing (as amended by Laws No. 36/2014, 8/2015, 130/2016 and 22/2022) and its CBE-issued Executive Regulation (as consolidated); Companies Law No. 194 of 2020 (arts. 85, 102) requiring registers of shareholders and beneficial owners; FRA Board Decree No. 22 of 2021 (as amended by Decree No. 220 of 2022) on UBO disclosure for non-banking entities; Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 and GAFI implementing decisions on incorporation disclosure.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation and Certificate of Good Standing of each foreign corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Home-country companies registry (e.g., Companies House, Delaware Division of Corporations, HK Companies Registry)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille if origin is a Contracting State (effective for Egypt since 14 December 2022); otherwise Egyptian Consular Legalization at the issuing state

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copies of passports and proof of residential address of all beneficial owners (UBOs) and designated managers
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport-issuing authority and local notary in the state of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization in the issuing state + Hague Apostille (or Egyptian Consular Legalization for non-Hague states)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Board Resolution and Power of Attorney appointing the Egyptian incorporation agent and local counsel
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate secretary and notary public in the parent jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Egyptian Consular Legalization, as applicable

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter evidencing financial standing and SWIFT LC/TT funding capability of the shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing bank of the contributing shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Bank officer certification notarized in the issuing jurisdiction + Hague Apostille (or consular legalization)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: ISO 13485 / CE / FDA clearance certificate for the color Doppler ultrasound console (device regulatory evidence)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National competent authority or Notified Body holding the original clearance
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille of the certificate + certified Arabic translation for the Egyptian Drug Authority (EDA) file

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Compulsory pre-filing screening of all directors, shareholders holding 25% or more, senior managers and authorized bank signatories against OFAC SDN (including the 50% rule), UN Security Council consolidated list, EU and UK HMT sanctions, the Official Gazette terrorist list maintained under the Egyptian AML Law No. 80 of 2002, and World Bank/IFC/EBRD debarment lists. PEP identification covers foreign PEPs, senior domestic officials (President, ministers, legislators, senior judiciary, CBE and military leaders) and close associates per FATF risk-based guidance; any PEP or indirect controller holding 10% or more triggers enhanced CDD and senior-management approval prior to incorporation.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: GAFI Investor Portal / One-Stop-Shop E-Corporate system (investorportal.gafi.gov.eg), integrated with the Commercial Registry of the Ministry of Trade and Industry
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be registered in Arabic; a Latin transliteration may be added as a trade name but the Arabic script is the authoritative registration. The legal-form suffix 'ذات مسؤولية محدودة' (LLC) is mandatory. Foreign-only names, non-transliterable acronyms, or names using non-Arabic scripts are rejected absent a justified Arabic phonetic rendering.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Foreign country or international tokens (e.g., International, American, Euro) requiring ministerial consent
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Within 30 days of the GAFI name-rejection notice, the applicant files a written administrative appeal with the GAFI Investment Processing Center, citing Companies Law No. 194 of 2020 and attaching an amended Arabic name reservation. If denied, the applicant may institute annulment proceedings before the State Council administrative courts within the statutory 60-day filing window, seeking suspension and cancellation of the administrative decision.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Conditionally permissible for administrative or correspondence registration only. A verifiable physical administrative address must be provided to GAFI, and the EDA-licensed manufacturing premise for the ultrasound console must be separate, fixed and subject to on-site compliance. A pure virtual-office mailbox cannot satisfy commercial substance or EDA establishment licensing.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Egyptian Companies Law No. 159 of 1981 (Articles 102-111 for Limited Liability Companies) as amended by Law No. 94 of 2005; Investment Law No. 72 of 2017; Executive Regulations thereof
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) – Companies Registration and Commercial Registry Department
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Certificate of Incorporation (Shahadat Al-Qayd Al-Markazi) issued upon registration of the LLC's Articles of Association (Aqd Al-Sharika) and commercial registration in the Sijill Tijari
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital under Law 159/1981; capital is fixed in the Articles of Association and must be fully subscribed at formation. Shares must be fully paid before incorporation, with the initial deposit held in a temporary escrow bank account; the licensing authority for medical-device manufacturing may require a higher specifically assigned capital based on the industrial operating plan.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTIONS OF THE FOUNDERS OF [LLC NAME] LLC, adopted on [date]. FIRST: The Articles of Association presented to this meeting are approved, the share subscription is declared closed, and shares are allotted to each founder as recorded in Schedule A. SECOND: The registered office is fixed at [address], Cairo Governorate, Egypt; the manager is hereby instructed to execute a lease agreement and complete the commercial registration. THIRD: The founders appoint [Name] as General Manager, [Name] as Compliance Officer, and [Name] as Tax Representative, each holding office under the Articles of Association. FOURTH: All lawful acts already performed for incorporation, including bank account opening, are hereby ratified. FIFTH: This resolution becomes effective immediately upon signing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Reserve corporate name and freeze legal form
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI – One-Stop Shop / Electronic Name Reservation Portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit an online or counter name-reservation request for the proposed Egyptian LLC name, confirming compliance with Egyptian naming rules and the absence of conflicting commercial registrations. Pay the nominal reservation fee and obtain the official name availability certificate.
required_dossiers: Completed GAFI name reservation application form
Passport copies of all founding partners
Power of attorney if a representative files on behalf of founders
Statement confirming the intended corporate activity (ISIC 3250)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected or queried, file a revised alternative name within five business days or lodge a written appeal to the GAFI Name Committee for review.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Draft and notarize the Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministry of Justice – Licensed Notary Public Office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the Arabic-language Articles of Association specifying the LLC’s registered office, capital, share allocation, management, dispute resolution, and purpose. All founders or their attorneys must appear before the notary, whose certification is a mandatory prerequisite to commercial registration.
required_dossiers: Name reservation certificate
Draft Articles of Association signed by all founders
Original valid passports or national identity cards
Attorneys’ powers of attorney if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary objects to any clause or identity documentation, correct the defective articles or submit supplementary civil status documents to the same notary office without restarting the full process.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Open temporary escrow account and deposit paid-up capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Authorized commercial bank in Egypt (e.g., National Bank of Egypt, Banque Misr)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Instruct the appointed General Manager to open an unrestricted temporary account in the name of the LLC to be formed. Deposit the fully subscribed capital or transfer it through a TT-Wire / encumbered escrow structure, and obtain a bank certificate evidencing the deposit amount and account holder in readiness for the GAFI submission.
required_dossiers: Notarized Articles of Association
Name reservation certificate
Valid IDs of authorized signatories
Pro-forma board resolution appointing the account signatory
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank requests additional Know-Your-Customer documentation or amends the AML classification, provide corporate background letters and source-of-funds declarations; re-issue the bank certificate once the account is in good standing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submit incorporation file to GAFI and obtain commercial registration certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI – Companies Registry / One-Stop Shop (Dokki Headquarters or branch offices)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the completed incorporation package, including the notarized Articles of Association, bank certificate, lease consent or registered-office letter, and tax-registration form. After examination and payment of statutory fees, GAFI issues the Certificate of Incorporation and requests the Commercial Registry listing.
required_dossiers: Notarized Articles of Association
Bank capital-deposit certificate
Registered-office lease or deed of ownership
Tax Identification Number preliminary form
Copy of share subscription schedule / allotment table
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If GAFI raises a compliance or data mismatch query, address the objection in writing through the GAFI electronic case system within thirty days, submitting the specific missing certificate or corrected charter clause; a temporary business approval can be issued pending final cure.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Register for tax, social insurance, and foreign-trade operations
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA), Nasser Social Insurance Organization, General Organization for Export and Import Control (GOIEC) at the Ministry of Trade and Industry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the post-incorporation registrations: obtain the Tax Card, register for corporate income tax and value-added tax, and register the company and its employees with social insurance. For medical-device export activities, enroll with GOIEC and the competent medical-device regulator to secure the importer/exporter code applicable to the commercial model.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation and Commercial Registry excerpt
Tax registration forms and Tax Card application
Notarized lease contract for the registered office
List of shareholders and directors/managers with national IDs
Bank account certificate and capital deposit certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a registration is rejected or taxed retroactively, submit a corrective declaration through the ETA’s voluntary-return portal, provide social-insurance contribution schedules, and re-apply for the GOIEC code after obtaining the industrial license and medical-device regulatory approval.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Industrial Development Authority (IDA) – Ministry of Trade and Industry
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Industrial Operations License for Medical Device Manufacturing (issued under Industrial Licensing Law No. 15 of 2017)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Full EIA Report – Category A (High Environmental Impact) under Law No. 4 of 1994 as amended by Law No. 9 of 2009, applicable to medical electrical equipment and imaging device manufacturing facilities.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with Ministerial Decree No. 338 of 1995: treated wastewater BOD ≤ 30 ppm, COD ≤ 60 ppm, TSS ≤ 30 ppm; ambient VOC emission limit ≤ 25 mg/m³ for cleaning and assembly processes; hazardous waste handling, storage, and disposal in accordance with Law No. 202 of 2020 and its executive regulations.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification from the Civil Defense Authority (General Directorate of Civil Defense) including approval of fire alarm and suppression systems suitable for electronics assembly; structural load inspection certificate issued by a licensed engineering design firm confirming floor-loading capacity for ultrasound console production; occupational health and workplace clearance from the Ministry of Manpower covering ventilation, electrostatic discharge controls, and operator safety protocols for medical electronic equipment assembly.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) – www.eta.gov.eg; e-taxation portal for TIN and VAT registration
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign entity applying for Egyptian TIN/VAT ID must register through the ETA portal. Required submissions include legalized certificate of incorporation, articles of association, notarized power of attorney, local registered address certificate, bank reference certificate, and director/officer ID documents. Non-residents typically must appoint a resident tax representative; ETA verification and issuance completes the TIN/VAT registration.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box pass-through election under Egyptian tax law; LLCs are taxed at entity level under Egypt Corporate Income Tax Law No. 91 of 2005. Hybrid mismatch elections are not domestically available; Egypt applies MLI provisions and substance-based carve-outs where relevant, subject to transfer pricing and thin capitalization rules.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EGP 500,000 annual taxable turnover; separate e-invoicing mandate thresholds per ETA phase-in schedule
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory e-invoicing and e-receipts through ETA-approved digital channels. Taxpayers above prescribed thresholds must use ETA e-invoicing REST APIs, integrate with the ETA clearance server for real-time invoice validation, print compliant QR codes, and obtain digital signatures/stamps before issuance.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods are zero-rated if goods physically leave Egypt and are covered by verified export customs declarations; direct international transport services and ancillary export services qualify. Services provided to non-residents and effectively consumed outside Egypt may also qualify for 0% VAT, subject to ETA conditions and supporting contracts.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (ACL/DEC form) stamped and signed by customs
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing physical export
Inward Remittance Certificate issued by an Egyptian bank
Proof of VAT zero-rating justification per ETA guidelines
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Fraudulent or unsupported export zero-rating claims expose the taxpayer to retrospective VAT assessment, input VAT credit clawback, monthly late payment surcharge (up to 2% per month), and penalties under Law No. 67 of 2016 and Tax Fraud Law, including fines up to EGP 250,000 and imprisonment; customs and e-invoice integration records are primary audit evidence.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Egypt (CBE), acting under the Central Bank and Banking System Law No. 194 of 2020. Foreign-exchange transactions are conducted through licensed banks and authorized financial institutions. Import, export, customs, and investment documentation may also involve the Egyptian Customs Authority, the General Organization for Export and Import Control, and the General Authority for Investment and Free Zones.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Egyptian pound is not freely convertible in the practical treasury sense. Current-account payments, including legitimate imports, service fees, dividends, loan servicing, and other business payments, are generally permitted through licensed banks subject to documentary support, sanctions screening, tax status, customs evidence, and bank liquidity. Capital-account transactions, including foreign direct investment, capital reductions, intercompany loans, and repatriation of invested capital, require enhanced documentation and bank review. Foreign shareholders may generally remit dividends and proceeds from a lawful capital reduction or liquidation after approval of financial statements, satisfaction of tax and corporate requirements, and submission of supporting resolutions and bank records. Banks may delay execution because of foreign-currency liquidity, enhanced due diligence, incomplete beneficial-ownership evidence, unpaid taxes, unresolved customs matters, or inconsistent transaction classifications. No blanket guarantee exists that a bank will provide foreign currency on demand.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Egypt does not generally impose a universal statutory requirement that every exporter surrender a fixed percentage of export proceeds or convert them into Egyptian pounds. Export proceeds should be collected and handled through licensed banks in accordance with applicable CBE instructions, banking procedures, customs records, and export-control requirements. The bank normally requires linkage between the export declaration, commercial invoice, transport documents, certificate of origin where applicable, collection or letter-of-credit terms, and the incoming funds. A single universally applicable statutory repatriation deadline and mandatory conversion ratio should not be assumed; applicable timing may depend on the product, export regime, customs treatment, financing structure, bank policy, and current CBE or customs instructions. The company should obtain written confirmation from its servicing bank before each export program and maintain a reconciliation of export declarations, receivables, collections, and any outstanding balances.

Capital Escrow Account / Foreign-Currency Operational Account / Egyptian-Pound Operational Account
Capital Escrow Account / Foreign-Currency Operational Account / Egyptian-Pound Operational Account

Foreign-Currency Operational Account / Egyptian-Pound Operational Account / Trade-Finance Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low to Medium for core treasury operations. An offshore electronic-money institution or payment institution generally cannot replace an Egyptian licensed bank for local collection, Egyptian-pound accounts, statutory capital accounts, import settlement, customs-linked payments, payroll, tax payments, or regulated foreign-exchange execution. Offshore EMI accounts may be used for limited incoming or outgoing commercial payments only where the Egyptian servicing bank accepts the structure, the payment purpose is lawful, correspondent-bank controls are satisfied, and full source-of-funds, beneficial-ownership, invoice, contract, and tax documentation is available. The company should not use personal accounts, unlicensed payment intermediaries, informal value-transfer channels, or account structures designed to circumvent CBE controls.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Egyptian banks commonly require original or properly legalized corporate documents, specimen signatures, identification of directors and authorized signatories, beneficial-owner verification, and an in-person meeting or branch attendance for at least the authorized signatory or local representative. Remote onboarding may be available for selected customers, subject to bank policy, video verification, notarization, consular legalization, apostille availability, certified Arabic translation where required, and enhanced due diligence. Foreign directors are not universally required to travel to Egypt, but a local authorized representative, attorney-in-fact, or signatory may need to attend. The bank's written onboarding checklist should be obtained before incorporation funding or shipment commitments.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unclear ultimate beneficial ownership, nominee shareholders, bearer-like ownership features, or ownership chains through multiple offshore entities
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified constitutional documents for every entity in the chain; current registers of shareholders and directors; ownership chart to each natural-person beneficial owner; passports and address evidence; notarized powers of attorney; UBO declarations; audited financial statements; and commercial rationale for the ownership structure.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Foreign shareholder funding that does not match the registered capital, shareholder resolution, subscription agreement, or declared investment purpose
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Shareholder and board resolutions; capital subscription or investment agreement; commercial-register and investment-authority filings; bank-approved funding instructions; remitter-to-shareholder relationship evidence; source-of-funds and source-of-wealth evidence; SWIFT payment message; and post-receipt capital-account reconciliation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Medical-device manufacturing and trading activity with inconsistent licenses, product classifications, or import and export descriptions
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Commercial-register extract; tax-card evidence; industrial and operating licenses; medical-device registration or applicable regulatory approvals; product technical files; HS-code analysis; supplier and customer contracts; certificates of origin; customs records; and written explanation of manufacturing, distribution, and export flows.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Large or rapid foreign-currency inflows and outflows, circular transfers, unexplained intercompany movements, or payments through high-risk jurisdictions
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Rolling cash-flow forecast; transaction map; intercompany agreements; transfer-pricing support; invoices and delivery evidence; purchase orders; bills of lading; customs declarations; bank statements; management accounts; counterparty KYC; sanctions screening results; and documented treasury approval controls.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Export proceeds not reconciled to customs declarations, overdue receivables, credit notes, returns, or third-party settlement
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Export declaration register; invoices; contracts; shipping and delivery documents; collection instructions; customer confirmations; credit-note and return documentation; aging report; bank collection evidence; explanations for timing differences; and management certification of outstanding export proceeds.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Payments involving sanctioned persons, restricted jurisdictions, dual-use equipment, military end users, or unclear medical-device end use
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Counterparty and UBO screening; end-user certificates; end-use statements; distributor due diligence; sanctions-screening logs; export-control classification; product specifications; licenses or no-license determinations; contractual sanctions clauses; and escalation approval by compliance counsel.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Tax, customs, social-insurance, or corporate-registration irregularities
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Valid tax registration; tax-clearance or filing evidence where applicable; customs account records; social-insurance compliance evidence; annual returns; audited accounts; general-assembly minutes; corporate-register extract; beneficial-owner filings; and written remediation plan for any historic deficiency.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Use of personal accounts, cash-heavy settlement, informal remittance, or third-party payment without commercial justification
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Written prohibition policy; payment-approval matrix; bank statements demonstrating institutional settlement; counterparty payment instructions; three-way payment agreement where lawful; invoice and contract trail; exception approval; and remediation evidence showing cessation of non-compliant practices.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Mismatch between the stated medical-imaging manufacturing model and website, invoices, customs codes, bank descriptions, or actual transaction counterparties
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Consistent business profile; product catalogue; factory or contract-manufacturing evidence; bills of materials; supplier agreements; customer pipeline; website and marketing review; transaction-purpose matrix; board-approved business plan; and explanatory memorandum addressing any legacy or ancillary activities.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Route shareholder equity, paid-in capital, or qualifying shareholder loans through a designated Egyptian licensed bank into the company's approved foreign-currency or capital account. The remitter name should match the documented shareholder or approved lender, and the transfer narrative should identify the legal entity, investment or loan purpose, and relevant agreement or resolution. Prior to remittance, provide the bank with constitutional documents, investment or loan agreement, shareholder and board approvals, capital-registration evidence where applicable, UBO information, source-of-funds evidence, and expected payment details. The bank should confirm the acceptable purpose classification, account destination, required Central Bank or investment documentation, and treatment of any conversion into Egyptian pounds. Retain the SWIFT message, bank credit advice, exchange confirmations, capital-account ledger, and corporate filings. Do not split transfers, route funds through unrelated third parties, or use an offshore wallet to avoid Egyptian bank review.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Use the Egyptian company's licensed bank for supplier payments, preferably from a documented foreign-currency account when permitted and subject to available liquidity and bank approval. Standard rails include SWIFT customer credit transfer, commonly MT103 or its ISO 20022 equivalent, for open-account or advance payments, and documentary letters of credit, including commercial import LCs, where the bank requires documentary control. A compliant payment file should contain the purchase contract, pro forma or commercial invoice, purchase order, HS code, product description, supplier and UBO information, shipping terms, import or customs documents where applicable, end-use information, sanctions screening, and tax or withholding analysis. For exports, use documentary collection, export LC, or bank-supported trade settlement with invoice, transport document, customs declaration, certificate of origin, insurance document where applicable, and customer payment evidence. The company should reconcile bank debits, customs records, inventory, accounts payable, and foreign-exchange conversion records.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable foreign-exchange forwards with a licensed Egyptian bank, limited to documented underlying receivables, payables, capital commitments, or other genuine commercial exposure and subject to bank suitability, tenor, collateral, and documentation requirements.

Currency swaps or foreign-exchange swaps arranged with an authorized bank for liquidity and maturity management, subject to CBE-regulated bank permissions, underlying exposure analysis, counterparty limits, and accounting documentation.

Non-deliverable forwards may be available through authorized banks or offshore counterparties for selected currencies, but Egyptian availability, settlement currency, enforceability, reporting, and repatriation treatment are transaction-specific. They should not be used to evade Egyptian FX controls and require legal and bank confirmation before execution.

Currency options or option-based structures may be available only where the authorized bank permits them and the company demonstrates a genuine commercial exposure, understands premium and mark-to-market risks, and satisfies suitability and documentation requirements.

Hedging policy controls should require board-approved limits, documented exposure forecasts, counterparty approval, segregation of dealing and confirmation functions, confirmation matching, valuation controls, collateral monitoring, hedge-accounting analysis, and periodic review of CBE, bank, tax, and accounting requirements.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax (CIT) return for the LLC
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before April 30 following a calendar-year tax period; within four months of fiscal year-end where an alternative tax period has been pre-approved by the ETA (Law 91/2005, Art. 78).
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Delay tax at 2% per month on unpaid tax plus statutory late-filing penalties; persistent default triggers enforced collection, bank attachment, and a deemed assessment by the ETA. Egyptian Law does not provide automatic administrative strike-off; dissolution or reinstatement proceeds only through the competent courts.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: By January 31 following the end of the tax year; supporting monthly VAT returns are due by the 30th of each succeeding month (Law 67/2016).
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing fines of EGP 1,000-5,000 (approx. USD 21-105) per unfiled return; delay tax of 2% per month on unpaid VAT; repeated violations escalate to tax prosecution and suspension of the ETA tax-compliance certificate.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Approval and filing of annual audited financial statements by the Partners' Assembly
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Partners' Assembly of the LLC; copy transmitted to the GAFI Companies Registry where independent audit is compulsory
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: The Partners' Assembly must approve the year-end balance sheet, managers' report, and financial statements within six months after the fiscal year-end, i.e., by June 30 for a December 31 year-end (Companies Law No. 194/2020).
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Unapproved or unfiled audited financial statements for two consecutive fiscal years enable GAFI to issue corrective notices, suspend compliance certificates, and request judicial dissolution or compulsory liquidation of the LLC.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Ultimate Beneficial Owner (UBO) register confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual confirmation by June 30 following a December 31 fiscal year-end; interim register updates within 30 days of any transfer of quotas, change in controlling owners, or change of managers.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines and formal notices for non-disclosure under Companies Law No. 194/2020 as amended by Law No. 185/2020; concealed ownership may provoke suspension of the commercial registration and freezing of corporate actions until the UBO register is rectified.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Commercial Registration (Trade Registry) status maintenance and five-year renewal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Commercial Registry at GAFI (one-stop investment window)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual data verification is coordinated with the CIT filing; registrations are formally renewed every five years; any transfer of quotas, change of managers, or scope modification must be registered within 30 days of occurrence (Law 34/1976).
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines prescribed under the Commercial Registration Law; a lapsed renewal causes the Commercial Registry to classify the company as inactive and to withhold certificates required for banking, customs, and export operations; judicial dissolution is the ultimate remedy.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: An independent certified auditor is mandatory where the LLC's paid-up capital exceeds EGP 250,000 (approx. USD 5,300); where any partner validly requests an audit; where the company is subject to consolidated financial supervision; or where the articles of association, lenders, or ETA/GAFI require audited financial statements.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Egyptian Accounting Standards (EAS), substantially converged with IFRS, apply to all registered LLCs; IFRS as issued by the IASB governs listed companies and financial institutions supervised by the Financial Regulatory Authority; accounting books must be maintained in legible Arabic or bilingual form.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under Companies Law No. 194/2020 as amended by Law No. 185/2020 and GAFI beneficial-ownership rules, the LLC must identify and record every natural person who directly or indirectly owns 25% or more of the quotas or who otherwise exercises control; the UBO register must remain at the registered office, must be updated within 30 days after any quota transfer or control change, and must be confirmed annually to GAFI by June 30 following a December 31 fiscal year-end.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (Partners/Quota Holders) with transfer annotations

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 900-2,500 per annum for a professional registered-office and corporate secretarial service in Cairo; USD 1,800-3,500 when combined with GAFI correspondence handling, tax-card maintenance, and notarial coordination.
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 3,000-7,500 per annum for a certified independent audit engagement of a small-to-mid manufacturing/export LLC under EAS/IFRS; USD 1,800-3,000 additional for annual CIT/VAT return compilation and compliance drafting.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Investments approved under Investment Law No. 72/2017 may benefit from investment deductions, accelerated depreciation, and tax stabilisation. Export-oriented facilities operating under a GAFI Free Zone or the Suez Canal Economic Zone can benefit from a 0% corporate tax rate on export profits for the duration of the zone licence. ISIC 3250/NAICS 334510 manufacturing of diagnostic medical scanning equipment is not itself entitled to a blanket holiday, but component-import and labour-intensive assembly are eligible for customs relief and the general investment-law deduction.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form No. 20 - Corporate Income Tax Return; submitted electronically through the Egyptian Tax Authority unified e-filing portal and physically or digitally to the competent tax office.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within four months after the end of the accounting year. A calendar-year LLC must file by 30 April unless the Egyptian Tax Authority grants an extension.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Commercial registration number, tax card number, unified registry number, legal form, and the registered head office address in Egypt.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State the Egyptian legal representative, branch or LLC registration number, and the address of the foreign shareholder/head office. Attach the notarized appointment of the local manager.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Opening and closing dates of the fiscal year; indication of whether the period is exactly 12 months and whether a calendar-year or special fiscal-year basis is adopted.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the foreign parent’s fiscal year differs, attach the ETA approval for the special fiscal year and ensure no gap or overlap with the Egyptian LLC's accounting period.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Principal and secondary activities, using the ISIC/NACE codes, including assembly, calibration, sale, and distribution of color Doppler ultrasound consoles.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Clearly describe the role as importer-distributor, contract manufacturer, or licensed assembler. Identify any related-party dealers and the countries of final export customers.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Export sales, local sales, service revenue, cost of goods sold, imported components, wages, depreciation, freight, and financing costs.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report gross export sales per market, invoice value, and discounts. Attach a schedule showing intercompany purchase prices, subcontracting fees, and group royalties.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Non-deductible provisions, entertainment expense disallowance, excess interest, unrealized foreign-exchange adjustments, and transfer-pricing adjustments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign head-office management fees are deductible only if effectively connected to the Egyptian activity, properly documented, and subject to arm's-length analysis. Royalty add-backs and WHT evidence must be attached.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Foreign tax credits, Egyptian tax credits withheld at source, unilateral credits, and DTA-reduced rates applied to dividends, interest, or royalties.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach a valid Tax Residency Certificate, beneficial-ownership declaration, and ETA treaty-relief approval. Only taxes actually paid and not refundable may be credited.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing triggers a penalty of EGP 10,000 to EGP 50,000 and a monthly late-payment surcharge of 2% on the unpaid tax, capped at the tax due. Understated or false returns invite re-assessment, fines of up to three times the evaded tax, and criminal prosecution.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% on dividends or profit shares distributed by an Egyptian LLC to a non-resident shareholder under Article 58 of Law No. 91 of 2005. Qualifying free-zone profits distributed into reinvestment under GAFI-approved terms may benefit from exemption treatment.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To apply a reduced DTA rate, the non-resident shareholder must submit a treaty-relief claim to the Egyptian Tax Authority before distribution, together with the current Tax Residency Certificate, a beneficial-ownership statement, shareholding details, and payment date confirmation. The ETA may issue an advance approval; otherwise the statutory 10% is withheld and the excess can be reclaimed by refund application within the relevant limitation period.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding is 20% on royalties and 20% on interest paid to non-residents. Applicable double taxation agreements typically reduce royalties and interest to 10%-15%, subject to beneficial ownership and the absence of a permanent establishment. Related-party interest is also tested under thin-capitalization and transfer-pricing rules.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Mandatory Egyptian TP disclosure form and Local/Master File documentation are required when the aggregate annual value of controlled transactions exceeds EGP 10,000,000. The ETA may nonetheless require documentation below this threshold where the taxpayer's profit margin has no reasonable business justification or the controlled price deviates materially from the arm's-length range.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Egypt has not enacted a standalone UAE-style Economic Substance Regulation, but the ETA and administrative courts apply substance-over-form, beneficial-ownership analysis, and Art. 49-55 anti-abuse principles. A shell LLC with no real management, employees, premises, or contract risk in Egypt is re-characterized or disregarded, causing full re-assessment, DTA denial, and possible licence revocation.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion / False Invoicing of Medical Imaging Exports
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Under-reporting intra-group export revenue for color Doppler ultrasound consoles, issuing backdated credit notes, inflating component import prices from related suppliers, or channelling payments through non-operational accounts.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Re-assessment at best judgment, monetary fine of up to three times the evaded tax, imprisonment of up to five years, attachment of bank accounts, suspension of tax card, and denial of export clearance if the tax status is unresolved.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the local legal representative are personally and jointly liable for evaded tax plus penalties where fraud is established. The court may order travel bans, seizure of personal assets, and disqualification from board service.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating an Egyptian LLC with no employees, no physical office, no warehouse, no board meetings in Egypt, and no real decision-making, while using the entity to access treaty withholding relief and a lower tax profile.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Disregard of the legal entity under judicial anti-avoidance doctrine, re-attribution of all profits to the foreign principal, denial of treaty benefits, liability for full statutory tax plus late-payment surcharges, and potential administrative dissolution.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Nominee directors who sign declarations without substance face civil restitution for the unpaid tax and penalties; fraud-based findings remove limited-liability protection and enable asset freezing and travel bans.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to file the ETA TP disclosure form or Master/Local File despite controlled transactions exceeding EGP 10,000,000; absence of comparability analysis for import, distribution, and royalty payments related to the ultrasound console business.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: ETA best-judgment transfer-pricing adjustment, gross-up of adjusted income, statutory fine of up to EGP 1,000,000 for missing documentation, and publication or blacklisting of the non-compliant taxpayer.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The finance director and CEO may be held personally liable for the documentation fine where they certified false or missing intercompany price analyses. Where the omission is accompanied by concealment, criminal liability attaches.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Money Laundering / Payment Structuring Red Flags
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Accepting large cash settlement from unlicensed distributors, splitting TT wire transfers into amounts immediately below the reporting threshold, invoicing the same device to multiple shell buyers, or routing sale proceeds through jurisdictions on FATF watchlists.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Freezing and confiscation of all proceeds under Law No. 80 of 2002, criminal fines of EGP 10,000-100,000, imprisonment up to seven years, cancellation of the medical-device trading or manufacturing licence, and prohibition from future ETA clearance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who design or approve the payment structure are treated as principals in the money-laundering offence. The corporate veil is pierced for their personal assets, travel documents can be seized, and civil liability covers the full transaction value.
